main.description: Apply, or lift, a moderation label on an emoji, and publish it as a signed label from this AppView's labeler (see com.atproto.label.queryLabels). Requires auth as an AppView administrator. Account takedowns are made with the AppView's admin tools and are labelled automatically. Implemented by AppView.

uri.description: AT-URI of an indexed blue.moji.collection.item record (when lifting a label, the record need not be indexed any more).

val.description: The label value. 'bluemoji-takedown' removes the emoji from this AppView; 'bluemoji-adult' marks it adult-only.

neg.description: Lift the label instead of applying it.

exp.description: When the label expires, in the future. Omit for no expiry.

reason.description: A private note for the audit trail. Never published in the label.
